# Graphics.transition(N, mask, vague): the screen when the call returns (step N-1 of N),
# measured on the original runtime (RGSS103J.dll under Wine). A selection of the measurements.
# "w N vague L -> a | r g b": grey mask value L; a = result where old=255, new=0;
#   r g b = result where old=(200,50,0), new=(50,200,255)
#   rule: T = (255*(N-1)-1)/N; vague 0: w = 255 if L>=T else 0; else w = 0 if L<=T else
#         min(255,(L-T)*255/vague); result = new if w==0 else new + (((old-new)*(w+1))>>8)
# "lum r g b -> L": the mask value of a coloured mask pixel, from N=2, vague=255, where the
#   result for old=255, new=0 is L-127. Only colours that floor(0.2989r+0.5866g+0.1145b)
#   reproduces are selected; the original is one higher for a few others.
